errors.fix: Direct substitution is the first thing to try. If f is a polynomial or a rational function whose denominator is not zero at a, the limit is simply f(a).
When substitution gives 0/0 the form is indeterminate. An indeterminate form 0/0 does not mean the limit fails to exist; it means we must simplify before substituting again.
